title: Agent Archivist receipt-key issuance result (archivist.cli-result/v1)
description: The public result of `admin receipt-key`: the receipt-key-v1 certificate needed to sign verifiable receipts and the tenant-authority-signed immutable control record published for offline verification. The generated private seed is written only to the configured mode-restricted file; a public certificate sidecar is written beside it. The private seed and filesystem paths appear in neither public value.

x-archivist.compatibility: member additions are additive within v1 per plan Section 7.1; redefining or removing a member is a v2 event

certificate.description: The independently signed public certificate embedded by value in receipts.

record.description: The immutable public control record published under the receipt key ID.
